channel.title: Client work on TrimGem
channel.description: Recent content in Client work on TrimGem

item.title: Cotton-blend all-over lace DI320517T
item.description:
Allover lace fails when the fibre split on the invoice does not match what the mill actually warped. DI320517T is one of the cotton-blend yardage articles we keep on the live shelf. The mill ticket, not a moodboard, is what went to bulk.

Product page: Cotton-blend all-over lace DI320517T.

item.title: Cotton-blend all-over lace D625104CW
item.description:
Bridal overlays are judged next to skin and next to a camera flash. A 70% cotton ticket is why this article was chosen over a cheaper nylon allover in the same motif family.

Product page: Cotton-blend all-over lace D625104CW.

item.title: Cotton-blend all-over lace DC620030W
item.description:
US programmes care about the fibre line as much as the flower. This case is a colourway on a live yardage SKU, not a new mill article invented for the photo.

Product page: Cotton-blend all-over lace DC620030W.

item.title: Cotton-blend all-over lace D625103XW
item.description:
Two cotton-blend allovers can look the same on a phone. 52% nylon versus 70% cotton is a different garment. The SKU is the decision.

Product page: Cotton-blend all-over lace D625103XW.

item.title: Ivory Crochet Lace Trims
item.description:
Cotton crochet and chemical eyelash are not interchangeable on lingerie elastic. 2601028-A stays a crochet ticket.

Product page: Ivory Crochet Lace Trims.

item.title: Black Floral Eyelash Lace
item.description:
Eyelash lace is a face problem as much as a colour problem. The live SKU is nylon eyelash, not a cotton crochet dyed black.

Product page: Black Floral Eyelash Lace.

item.title: Black Stretch Lace Edgings
item.description:
Stretch lace is a recovery number, not a black colour. The spandex is on the ticket for a reason.

Product page: Black Stretch Lace Edgings.

item.title: Black and White Floral Lace Tapes
item.description:
Organza floral tapes bruise in a tight roll. Packing is part of the SKU, not an afterthought.

Product page: Black and White Floral Lace Tapes.

item.title: Ivory Bridal Flower Appliques
item.description:
2601030 is a bridal flower with pearl and sequin on tulle. The case is about count and sew-down, which is how a sewing floor actually uses an applique.

Product page: Ivory Bridal Flower Appliques.

item.title: Seashell Lace Applique Collection
item.description:
Shell on lace is a sew-down and packing problem. The live collection SKU is cotton lace with shell, which is what the carton held.

Product page: Seashell Lace Applique Collection.

item.title: Navy Feather Sequin Flower Appliques
item.description:
Feather appliques fail in a deep carton. 2601031 is packed as a sewing component, not as millinery stock.

Product page: Navy Feather Sequin Flower Appliques.

item.title: Crochet Jellyfish and Starfish Motifs
item.description:
The SKU is cotton crochet with pearl, not a printed motif. Pairing in the bag is how the sewing floor expected to find it.

Product page: Crochet Jellyfish and Starfish Motifs.

item.title: Ivory Guipure Lace-up Panel
item.description:
Lace-up panels fail on ribbon width more often than on the lace. The live SKU names both guipure and satin ribbon.

Product page: Ivory Guipure Lace-up Panel.

item.title: Eyelash Lace Eyelet Corset Panel
item.description:
Eyelets are hardware sitting in lace. M26010014 is specified as both, which is why the QC list has a pitch row.

Product page: Eyelash Lace Eyelet Corset Panel.

item.title: Beaded Shell V-Neck Lace Panel
item.description:
A beaded V is a geometry plus a sew-down. The SKU lists cotton lace, shell and crystal together because that is the construction.

Product page: Beaded Shell V-Neck Lace Panel.

item.title: Ivory Crochet Collar Panel
item.description:
Collars are measured, not just photographed. Cotton crochet M26010010 is a dimension on a card.

Product page: Ivory Crochet Collar Panel.

item.title: Pearl Cluster Sew-on Buttons
item.description:
Pearl clusters fail on shank and sew-down. The live SKU is glass pearl on metal, MOQ 100 pcs.

Product page: Pearl Cluster Sew-on Buttons.

item.title: Tweed Flower and Horn-Look Buttons
item.description:
Two button looks on one garment is a kit problem. 2601038 is sold as zinc and resin together, which is how the carton was built.

Product page: Tweed Flower and Horn-Look Buttons.

item.title: Sculpted Gold Sew-on Button
item.description:
Gold is a plating standard, not an adjective. X2-BTN-01 sits on the new-arrivals shelf because the sculpture and the plate are both specified.

Product page: Sculpted Gold Sew-on Button.

item.title: Swirl Knot Sew-on Button
item.description:
A knot button is a shank-length problem on knit. The live SKU is the swirl-knot on the arrivals shelf.

Product page: Swirl Knot Sew-on Button.

item.title: Irregular Marble Sew-on Button
item.description:
Irregular cannot mean unmeasured. X2-BTN-03 is a marble-look sew-on with a diameter window, which is what the QC list used.

Product page: Irregular Marble Sew-on Button.

item.title: Pin Buckle H10050-40
item.description:
H10050-40 is a bestseller pin buckle on this site. The case is strap width and plating, which is how a belt factory writes an RFQ.

Product page: Pin Buckle H10050-40.

item.title: Pin Buckle H10085-40
item.description:
Sister buckles fail when the second shape goes to a cheaper plater. Both SKUs are live 40 mm zinc pin buckles.

Product page: Pin Buckle H10085-40.

item.title: Pin Buckle PINBUCKLE-04
item.description:
A pin buckle RFQ should name the strap. PINBUCKLE-04 was sampled on fabric because that is what the buyer sews.

Product page: Pin Buckle PINBUCKLE-04.

item.title: Scarf Buckle 01
item.description:
This is the bestseller scarf buckle on the site. The case is silk abrasion, which is the actual use.

Product page: Scarf Buckle 01.

item.title: Fashion Hardware X2-195
item.description:
Fashion hardware on a scarf is a weight and a plate. X2-195 is a live zinc SKU, MOQ 200 pcs.

Product page: Fashion Hardware X2-195.

item.title: Scarf Buckle X2-202
item.description:
Scarf fabric changes the inner opening you need. X2-202 was sampled on twill because that was the brief.

Product page: Scarf Buckle X2-202.

item.title: Enamel Flower Clip X2-241
item.description:
Enamel clips fail in loose bags. X2-241 is on the new-arrivals shelf as a clip, and it ships as a clip.

Product page: Enamel Flower Clip X2-241.

item.title: Resin Butterfly Clip X2-271
item.description:
Resin on zinc is two materials and two failure modes. The live SKU lists both.

Product page: Resin Butterfly Clip X2-271.

item.title: Resin Leaf Pin X2-310
item.description:
A pin on knit is a stem diameter. X2-310 is a resin leaf on zinc, packed with the stem protected.

Product page: Resin Leaf Pin X2-310.

item.title: Gold Triangle Enamel Waist Chain
item.description:
Waist chains fail on length and on enamel. This SKU is a new-arrivals hardware piece with both named.

Product page: Gold Triangle Enamel Waist Chain.

item.title: Silver Daisy Waist Chain
item.description:
Silver is as easy to mix as gold if the plater is not named. The arrivals SKU is the daisy chain they reordered.

Product page: Silver Daisy Waist Chain.

item.title: Cowrie Pearl Waist Chain NB26010743
item.description:
Cowrie plus pearl is a set of materials, not a print. The live hardware SKU names the construction.

Product page: Cowrie Pearl Waist Chain NB26010743.

item.title: Snap Fastener JS-20100/20111/20122 (13/15/17mm)
item.description:
Snap programmes fail when 13 mm and 17 mm share a bag. The live SKU is already a three-size set.

Product page: Snap Fastener JS-20100/20111/20122 (13/15/17mm).

item.title: Pearl Bead and Stone Trim Collection
item.description:
This is a bestseller pearl-and-stone tape. Mesh plus stone is a press problem, which is what we locked.

Product page: Pearl Bead and Stone Trim Collection.

item.title: Shell and Pearl Fringe Trims
item.description:
Fringe with shell is packing and hang. The live SKU lists cotton tape, shell and pearl.

Product page: Shell and Pearl Fringe Trims.

item.title: Cotton Tassels and Tie Cords
item.description:
A bestseller tassel SKU. Length and pairing are the factory language, which is why the carton was counted that way.

Product page: Cotton Tassels and Tie Cords.

item.title: Black Macramé Fringe Trim
item.description:
Macramé fringe is a knot, not a print of a knot. The live SKU is polyester yarn X2-FR-05.

Product page: Black Macramé Fringe Trim.

item.title: Black and White Beaded Fringe Trim
item.description:
Beaded fringe is a glass-bead sew-down. X2-FR-04 is the live black-and-white article.

Product page: Black and White Beaded Fringe Trim.
